notes.title: Brand New Levels are Here!
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce a major update for Escape from Prison! Get ready to experience a fresh challenge with the addition of [b]10 brand new levels[/b] designed to test your wits and puzzle-solving skills in a different way than before! 🎉

[b]What’s New?[/b]

In this update, get ready to tackle [b]dual-room puzzles[/b] in each level. Each new level features not just one, but two interconnected rooms with intricate puzzles. 

Navigate your way through dual-room challenges 🚪🧩, strategizing and thinking on your feet to crack the codes and unlock your path to freedom. Test your puzzle-solving skills and enjoy a fresh, engaging experience. Update now and see if you can escape! 🔐

notes.title: Introducing the story behind the prison of Luhest
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Our latest update reveals the story behind the large web of crime centered around Beren's imprisonment. They call it a prison. But Luhest hides a deeper darkness. 👀

Hop on a journey of her fight for justice, help her gather all the evidence through levels, and eventually escape the prison. 

Our genius reporter doesn't give up. When they try to hush the truth, she'll make it scream. 

Enjoy the new narrative feature that makes your prison escape even more challenging!🤩
